s.note: the Chinese restaurant where the curse starts
s.how: Soak 50g rice vermicelli and chop. Mix with 300g pork mince, shredded wombok and grated carrot. Roll tightly in spring roll pastry and fry at 180C until crisp and blistered. Serve hot with sweet chilli sauce for dipping.

s.note: Anna's band rehearsing in the garage
s.how: Cut 600g chicken thigh into bite-size pieces. Dip in 2 beaten eggs, then in 1 cup flour mixed with 1 cup panko, 1 tsp paprika and salt. Shallow fry in batches for 4 minutes until golden, drain and serve with honey mustard.

m.how: Toss 800g chicken thigh pieces in cornflour and fry until crisp. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp soy sauce until bubbling and toss the chicken through. Scatter with sesame seeds and serve over steamed jasmine rice.

w.note: the fortune cookies that swap them
w.how: Whisk 2 egg whites with 80g sugar, then mix in 60g flour, 30g melted butter and a drop of vanilla. Spread thin rounds on a lined tray and bake at 180C for 6 minutes. Working quickly while hot, lay a fortune on each, fold and bend over a cup. Be careful what they say.

d.how: Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 2 tbsp jasmine tea leaves and pour over a litre of water just off the boil. Steep for 3 minutes, then pour into small cups. Sip slowly and try not to swap bodies with anyone.
